    • receiveTimerDTO

      void receiveTimerDTO(TimerDTO timerDTO)
      Method used to update the TimerDTO when either a player flips the timer or when the previous timer runs out and there's the need to notify all players about the status of the timer.
      This method is used exclusively during the ShipConstruction phase since it's the only place where the timer is relevant for the game.
      Parameters:
      timerDTO - The TimerDTO received by the client from the server

    • commitCommand

      void commitCommand(String playerNickname)
      Method used to trigger the onSuccess task set in the currently active command context, which was set up before sending the command to the server.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - The player whose onSuccess needs to be executed. Other players different from the given one won't execute the onSuccess task in their command context.

    • showError

      void showError(ErrorAnswer error)
      Method used to trigger the onError task set in the currently active command context, which was set up before sending the command to the server.
      Parameters:
      error - The error message explaining what went wrong in the previously performed action. It'll be displayed to the player to inform him about what happened and possibly what he has to do to send a correct command.

    • isCTXAvailable

      boolean isCTXAvailable()
      Returns:
      TRUE if the client it's invoked in has a command context setup, FALSE otherwise.

    • interruptCurrScreen

      void interruptCurrScreen()
      (NOTE: This method is used only in the TUI)
      Forces the inputThread to be interrupted when the current screen is blocked waiting for user input, allowing the game state to be transition to the next one.

    • updateShipConstructionComponent

      void updateShipConstructionComponent(ConstructionComponentDTO component)
      Updates the selected component's graphics in the component matrix that are selectable by each player during the ship construction phase when using the GUI.
      Parameters:
      component - The component that was picked from the selectable ones.

    • updateShipPlacedComponent

      void updateShipPlacedComponent(PlacedComponentDTO data)
      Updates for each player in the game the GUI graphics of the ship belonging to the player who placed the given component. This is done so that each player can see in-real-time how that particular player is building his ship.
      Parameters:
      data - The data of a component placed by a player.

    • placePlayerInTheBoard

      void placePlayerInTheBoard(String playerNickname)
      Updates the board GUI graphics to show a player on the board in the correct position when said player decides to finish building his ship.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - The player that was placed on the board following his request to conclude the ship construction phase.

    • updateShipRemovedComponent

      void updateShipRemovedComponent(FixedComponentDTO data)
      Updates for each player in the game the GUI graphics of the ship belonging to the player who removed the given component when fixing his ship. This is done so that each player can see in-real-time how that particular player is fixing his ship.
      Parameters:
      data - The data of a component removed by a player when fixing his ship.

    • updateShipPlacedLifeForm

      void updateShipPlacedLifeForm(PopulateShipComponentDTO data)
      Updates for each player in the game the GUI graphics of the ship belonging to the player who populated the given component when populating his ship. This is done so that each player can see in-real-time how that particular player is populating his ship.
      Parameters:
      data - The data of a component populated by a player when populating his ship.

    • updateVisuals

      void updateVisuals(CardRoundDTO data)
      Update the GUI visuals only during the CardRound game phase to reflect any changes caused by the use of an event card (e.g.: item withdraw/removal, destroyed components, lifeform removal, etc...).
